title: Executable company objectives playbook with dependency SLAs and escalation lanes
creator: Asha Kumar
description:
Goal: Produce an actionable playbook that converts company-level OKRs into an executable initiative slate with clearly assigned owners, hard dependencies, SLA expectations for decision handoffs, and formal escalation lanes. The playbook must be lightweight enough for weekly use by PM/Eng leads but rigorous enough to prevent stalled cross-functional work that impacts company KPIs.

Scope: company-level OKRs -> initiatives -> per-initiative success metrics -> explicit dependency matrix (owner + SLA) -> decision escalation lanes (2-level: PM Ops escalation, Exec escalation) -> gating criteria for milestone sign-off -> tooling templates (Confluence playbook + OKR tracker spreadsheet + dashboard widgets).

Why now: Multiple Q1 initiatives have been delayed due to unclear decision ownership and slow unblock times (average 7 business days). Leadership requested a repeatable mechanism to guarantee 48-hour SLAs for critical dependency responses and an escalation path for unresolved blocks.

Key constraints & trade-offs considered:
- Trade-off: Strict SLAs reduce ambiguity but add coordination overhead. We aim for a tiered SLA (48h for critical cross-team decisions, 5 business days for non-critical) to minimize overhead.
- Trade-off: Centralized gating vs. local autonomy. Decision: preserve local execution but require gating sign-off for company-impacting milestones.
- Data availability: not all initiatives currently emit the required success metrics; minimal instrumentation spec is part of the playbook.

Success criteria:
- Every company-level initiative has a mapped owner, dependency matrix, and SLA recorded in the playbook (target: 100% by 2026-04-01).
- Median unblock time for critical dependencies reduces from 7 business days to <= 2 business days within one cycle.
- No Q2 company OKR milestones delayed due to cross-team coordination failures (target: 95% on-time).

Deliverables:
- Playbook doc (Confluence): decision lanes, SLA matrix, templates for owners.
- Initiative mapping spreadsheet with ownership and dependency tags.
- Lightweight dashboard (Grafana) widget showing blocked initiatives and SLA breaches.
- Runbook for weekly cross-functional sync and exec escalation.

Stakeholders: Product (Asha, Liam), Eng leads (Ravi Patel, Zoe Martinez), Design (Nina Park), Reliability (Marcus Li), GTM (Sofia Alvarez), Legal/Security (Elena Novak) for gating checks.

Acceptance criteria: Confluence playbook approved by PM + 2 Eng leads + Design; rollout checklist completed and playbook linked in the company roadmap page.
